'''Ident badges''' were a form of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] identification. [[Dirk Harkness]] and [[Jai Raventhorn]] forged ident badges to infiltrate the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Golthan)|''Vengeance'']] at the [[Wroona Stardock]].
